review_type: Independent hostile source review at the strictest adversarial parity bar. Verified targeted improvements in commit a2aedaa9f53ff86874884d163053d48e5c8ba9fc against reference/MissionPlanner sources: CommsBLE (SimpleBleApi dynamic symbol resolution & write request scaffolding), CommsWinUSB (WinUsbApi dynamic symbol resolution & bulk pipe routing), mobile speech dispatch (iOS objc_getClass probing, Android native activity logging hook), and iOS packaging/simulator test verification.
verdict: REJECTED for exact-clone parity (Score: 5.0/10, capped at 5.0 due to open P1 findings). Commit a2aedaa9f53ff86874884d163053d48e5c8ba9fc introduced dynamic symbol loading via GetProcAddress for SimpleBLE (simpleble_adapter_get_handle, simpleble_adapter_scan_for, simpleble_peripheral_connect, simpleble_peripheral_disconnect, simpleble_peripheral_write_request) and WinUSB (WinUsb_Initialize, WinUsb_Free, WinUsb_ReadPipe, WinUsb_WritePipe), added write routing for BLE Nordic UART service/char UUIDs and WinUSB bulk endpoints (0x81 bulk-in, 0x01 bulk-out), added Objective-C runtime symbol querying (objc_getClass) in speech.rs, and verified host-independent packaging tests (5/5). However, under the hostile adversarial audit standard, a partial match or stub receives zero credit. Both targeted P1 findings remain open: BleTransport and WinUsbTransport initialize their driver handles (peripheral_handle and usb_handle) to None in open() and never connect or initialize device handles, meaning all write/read operations fall back to disconnected in-memory FIFO queues; BleTransport lacks an inbound notification callback (simpleble_peripheral_notify); iOS speech synthesis only queries class pointers without executing objc_msgSend to instantiate or trigger utterances; Android speech contains an uninvoked feature block with a log line without JNI class or method calls; and end-to-end runtime execution receipts from an actual mobile simulator or physical hardware remain absent.

scores.scale: 0 to 10 against an exact Mission Planner clone on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS. A partial match gets no credit. With any P0 or P1 open, the cap is 5.0 (uncapped intrinsic scores: overall 7.2, ui_ux 8.3, features 8.7, cross_platform_delivery 3.8).

findings.subsystem: Comms & Mobile Speech: Unconnected Driver Handles and Incomplete Audio FFI (R50-01 remainder)
evidence: In `crates/mp-core/src/comms.rs`:470-508, `BleTransport::open` initializes `peripheral_handle: None` without scanning (`simpleble_adapter_scan_for`) or connecting (`simpleble_peripheral_connect`) to the peripheral at `self.address`. As a result, `BleTransport::write` (line 526) never enters the `write_req` branch and always falls through to the internal `tx_buf` FIFO queue. Furthermore, `BleTransport::read` (line 511) has no inbound notification subscription (`simpleble_peripheral_notify`) and only pops from an empty `rx_buf`.

In `crates/mp-core/src/comms.rs`:585-616, `WinUsbTransport::open` initializes `usb_handle: None` without calling `CreateFileA` or `WinUsb_Initialize` on the device interface path `p`. As a result, `WinUsbTransport::read` (line 620) and `write` (line 644) never enter their pipe I/O branches and fall back to in-memory `rx_buf` and `tx_buf`.

In `crates/mp-app/src/speech.rs`:50-65, the iOS speech synthesis implementation queries `objc_getClass` for `AVSpeechSynthesizer` and `AVSpeechUtterance`, but never executes `objc_msgSend` to allocate, initialize, or speak an utterance (`[synth speakUtterance:utterance]`). It only logs an informational message.

In `crates/mp-app/src/speech.rs`:39-44, the Android speech implementation only logs an informational string under the `android-native-activity` feature and does not invoke JNI `FindClass` or `CallVoidMethod` for `android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech`, falling through to CLI subprocesses (`termux-tts-speak`, `am broadcast`).
findings.impact: Physical BLE telemetry radios and WinUSB connections cannot communicate with flight controllers. Telemetry audio callouts remain silent on standard iOS and Android installations.
findings.required_fix: In `mp-core/src/comms.rs`, instantiate and store active driver handles: for BLE, scan for the peripheral matching `address`, connect via `simpleble_peripheral_connect`, and register an inbound notification callback via `simpleble_peripheral_notify` to populate `rx_buf`; for WinUSB, open the device handle with `CreateFileA` and initialize WinUSB via `WinUsb_Initialize`. In `mp-app/src/speech.rs`, complete the Objective-C FFI bridge using `objc_msgSend` to allocate and trigger `AVSpeechSynthesizer` on iOS, and complete JNI method invocations for `android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech`.

findings.subsystem: Native Delivery: Real-Time Mobile Hardware and Simulator Execution Receipts (R50-02 remainder)
evidence: While packaging logic and metadata verification pass in `scripts/test_ios_packaging.py`, live execution receipts (such as `startup.capture.json` and `startup.png`) generated from an actual iOS Simulator instance or physical mobile device runtime have not been produced or recorded.
findings.impact: Mobile touch interactions, native rendering lifecycles, and OS permission dialogs remain unvalidated in live mobile runtime environments.
findings.required_fix: Execute automated simulator or device runs producing concrete runtime capture receipts.
